# Limitless

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 0 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: A quiet light marketing site after an acquisition: white page, slate 900 display at 60px with tight tracking, Greycliff, purple-500 used only on the star and one filled action, pill nav, a 24px letter card, and a small sign-in card that stops at Google and an email field.

Captured 2026-11-18, signed out (public marketing, docs, legal, help center, and the app.limitless.ai sign-in wall; Google and the email field were not used). Themes: light.

Tokens and component notes for the public Limitless site (limitless.ai), captured **2026-11-18**, signed out, in headless Chromium. Desktop is 1440×900. Phone is 390×844. The site paints one light theme. Captured routes: `/`, `/privacy`, `/developers`, `/about`, `/careers`, `/support`, `/terms`, `/privacy-policy`, `/for/voice-recorder`, `/for/students`, the `/pricing` 404, `app.limitless.ai/signin` (the wall only), and `help.limitless.ai/en/`.

Limitless is a Tailwind/Next.js marketing site on Greycliff. Colour is utility classes (slate, zinc, purple-500), not a custom-property system. The home page is an acquisition letter. Sign-in, the app, Pendant purchase, and account actions were not entered.

### Fonts (from README.md)

Greycliff (400, 500, 600, 700), loaded by Next as `__greycliff`. Licensed, not shipped. Tokens fall back to `system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, Open Sans, sans-serif`. Code uses `ui-monospace`.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

- The app behind `https://app.limitless.ai/signin`. Google and the email field were measured and not used.
- Pendant checkout. The site says the Pendant is no longer sold to new customers. No purchase flow was opened.
- Support chat on `/support`. It is a third-party widget. It was not opened.
- Help search results and article pages. The field was focused and not queried.
- Ashby careers and the Slack community invite. Both leave the site.
- Greycliff files. The family name is measured. The files are not in this package.
- Pressed states. They are forced pseudo-classes.
- Reduced motion. The product ignores it. That is recorded, not corrected.
- The phone sign-in shot is 1x. That host reports `devicePixelRatio` 1 while Playwright still writes a 2x PNG, so the shot was taken at 1x to match the page.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

1. **Do paint a white page and slate type.** Page is white, titles are slate 900, body is slate 600 ([home](screenshots/home-light-default.png)).
2. **Do spend purple on the mark and the one filled action.** Purple 500 is the star, the Copy button and developer anchors ([Copy](components/crops/copy-button-default.png)).
3. **Do use pills in the bar.** Nav links and Solutions are 9999px radius, 16px/600, with an 8% slate wash on hover ([nav](components/crops/nav-link-hover.png)).
4. **Do set display at 60px with tight tracking.** The acquisition headline and solution titles are 60px, tracking -1.5px ([hero](components/crops/hero-title-default.png)).
5. **Do round the letter card at 24px.** The acquisition letter is a soft card, not a flat column ([card](components/crops/letter-card-default.png)).
6. **Do keep the sign-in card quiet.** White, 8px radius, one Google button, one email field, on a pale field ([sign-in](screenshots/signin-light-default.png)).
7. **Don't invent a dark theme.** The public site does not paint one.
8. **Don't style the signed-in app from this package.** Lifelogs, Pendant settings and billing were not captured ([sign-in wall](screenshots/signin-light-default.png)).
9. **Don't follow Continue with Google or submit the email field.** Both leave the public surface.
10. **Don't copy the star or the Greycliff files.** The mark and the typeface are Limitless's. Tokens name the system.
